Scope: Static publisher-page, version, licensing, process/service-control and external-data risk review of MiTeC Task Manager DeLuxe 5.1.1; no payload executed and no process/service/reputation query performed

ProductPage.PublishedBehavior: Portable process/service/driver, network, session, startup, hardware and performance monitor. Includes an optional VirusTotal reputation link for processes/services, a session journal, Desktop Explorer and system information. The version history also describes start/stop/restart/terminate controls, optional automatic termination of suspended processes, process minidumps, system-update checks and CSV export of machine journal/user-account data for registered users. Exact external requests/data, dump contents, journal retention and no-install/no-trace behavior are not established here.
ProductPage.OperatingSystems: Publisher lists Windows XP-11 and Server 2003-2025; this is not RIDE target acceptance.
ProductPage.LicensePagePriceObservation: The product page lists a EUR 30 lifetime single-user license on the review date. The support EULA separately describes non-commercial unregistered use; local entitlement/redistribution are unresolved.

TermsPage.Observation: Support EULA states trial/unregistered freeware is for non-commercial use and lists named-user/build-machine, team, site and trial licensing. This does not establish owner-specific use or distribution rights.

PinnedArtifact.MemberSetObservation: Separate x86/x64 TMX and Desktop Explorer executables; no license, README or notice member recorded in the frozen inventory.

ReviewFindings: Frozen archive, page snapshot and four executable member hashes match. TMX files report FileVersion 5.1.1.0 but ProductVersion 5.0.0.0; Desktop Explorer files are separately versioned 2.0.0.0. Preserve these distinctions.

The published feature set can expose process arguments/details, account names, session history, network connections, hardware identifiers and service state. Process termination, service control and minidump creation can change system state or capture sensitive memory.

The VirusTotal process/service link, update checks and optional export behavior require separate data-flow review. Do not query VirusTotal or enable/configure any API key in source review; the exact query inputs and outbound requests are unspecified.
The publisher's no-install/no-traces claim is not verified by the page or archive inventory; actual file, registry, startup, journal and preference persistence remain unknown.

MigrationDisposition.Resolved: Current version, separate x86/x64 TMX/Desktop Explorer members, published monitoring/control surface, and reputation/export features are recorded.
MigrationDisposition.Partial: Local license entitlement, process/service action semantics, dump/journal sensitivity, persistence, VirusTotal/update data flow, component-suite rights, UI and activation remain unverified.
Deferred: No process termination, service change, live-process minidump, account/session export or VirusTotal/API query
Any later viewer acceptance must be read-only, use an isolated guest and synthetic data, with exact persistence and cleanup review
Windows target, UI and activation behavior through an approved guest workflow
MigrationDisposition.EstimateReason: Process/service and data-flow effects are better bounded, but license, runtime/recovery behavior and a complete legacy outcome remain open; no estimate deduction is justified.
